alex: quick note — ran a full perf sweep this morning on Mistral-7B (v0.4) comparing kernel selection + kv layout. saw a consistent ~18% throughput drop at 2k seq under our MQA config vs baseline. attaching logs: https://artifacts/redwood/perf/1965432100
mira: can you paste the bench numbers? 18% is pretty big for just kernel hints
alex: baseline (prod kernels): 120k tok/s, p95 42ms. current after recent kernel-selector change: 98k tok/s, p95 51ms. GPU util up ~6%, but memory churn and page faults increased on KV slab paging
sam: could be a num_key_value_heads mismatch — we had that bug where KV dims were rounded differently for MQA vs GQA. did you sample num_kv_heads?
alex: yes — MQA config ended up with num_key_value_heads=32 while model expects 48 for some layers (Mix of 32/48 across blocks). suspect fragmentation in paged KV layout. profiler shows many small allocations flagged as "kv_frag"
jordan: that smells like cache page fragmentation + RoPE scaling interactions. if RoPE scale increased effective seq dims then the kernel candidate might switch to a different GEMM path that doesn't handle non-contiguous KV well
ryan: any hot traces? can we repro with the microbench harness?
alex: repro script: ```
# run microbench
assay --model=mistral-7b --seq-len=2048 --batch=1 --mode=profile \
  --kv-layout=paged --kv-page-size=65536 --num_kv_heads=32 \
  --kernel-hint=auto
```
outputs: `tokens/s=98k, p95=51ms, page_faults=312`
mira: try forcing kernel-hint to `fused_gemm_fp16` vs `split_kv_gemm` — those had different ordering for kv copy paths. also try `--kv-layout=interleaved`
sam: note that Mixtral experiments showed similar regression when we increased RoPE_scale to 1.2 — maybe RoPE scaling changes key/value stride and triggers different kernel tiling heuristics
ryan: i'll kick off two assays in parallel: one forcing kernel, one switching kv layout. logs will go to the same artifact bucket. assigning myself 10m now :running_man:
perf-bot: started job 1965432112 (ryan) — assay(mistral-7b, kernel=fused_gemm_fp16)
perf-bot: started job 1965432120 (ryan) — assay(mistral-7b, kv_layout=interleaved)
jordan: another angle — check mapping of num_key_value_heads -> kv_dim. If kv_dim doesn't align with head packing (e.g., pack size 64) then the allocator pads and increases page churn. we saw this on Qwen-34B where kv_dim%pack != 0 caused ~10% slowdowns
mira: for now can we try a quick hotfix: override num_kv_heads to the model canonical (48) and fallback kernel to `legacy_gemm` to see if perf recovers? if yes, we have a short-term mitigation while we root cause selector rules
alex: tried that locally: `num_kv_heads=48` + `legacy_gemm` -> tokens/s=118k, p95=44ms, page_faults=28. big improvement. so two levers look promising
sam: we should also check the kernel-selection decision tree: it currently uses seq_len + head_dim + rope_scale to pick kernels. maybe add kv_contiguity flag from the allocator so it avoids kernels that assume contiguous KV storage
ryan: logging an issue: https://issues/redwood/IR-4623 with steps and logs. I'll upload the two assay outputs when done and annotate kernel traces (GEMM, copy, alloc)
jordan: long-term, let's add an integration test that runs a small set of MQA/GQA permutations (num_kv_heads {32,48,64}, kv_layout {paged,interleaved}) at seq=2048 and pins kernel choices. should catch selector regressions in CI
mira: agree. also add a perf regression alert tied to p95 > +10% for models in the verified catalog. that would have flagged this earlier
alex: action items: ryan -> collect assay outputs + confirm mitigation works on dedicated nodes; sam -> add kv_contiguity signal to kernel selector PR; jordan -> create CI integration test; mira -> add alert rule draft. I'll validate mitigation and then we decide if we revert selector change or add heuristics
ryan: started upload of artifacts 1965432145 -> https://artifacts/redwood/perf/1965432100/results.tar.gz 
mira: awesome. thanks team. once we have the traces i'll run a quick kernel-level diffs to see which code path added the extra memcopy
alex: one more note: we saw RoPE_scale config in model config at 1.15 for newer Mistral variants. that seems to correlate with kernel change. mention that in the issue
sam: sg. i'll draft selector tweak and include a small fallback to legacy_gemm if kv_layout=paged and num_kv_heads mismatch detected :thumbsup:
perf-bot: job 1965432112 (ryan) completed — tokens/s=116k, p95=45ms (kernel=fused_gemm_fp16)
perf-bot: job 1965432120 (ryan) completed — tokens/s=119k, p95=44ms (kv_layout=interleaved)
alex: looks like both interventions help. tentative root cause: selector picked a kernel optimized for contiguous large-kv but allocator produced many small paged chunks because of head/dim packing mismatch under MQA. leads to extra memcopies and page faults, which hit p95
jordan: documented hypothesis in IR-4623. we'll prioritize selector change + CI test. thanks
mira: closing loop — add a note to the rollout docs: when enabling new kernels, run the small MQA/GQA permute suite (seq 2k) to verify KV behavior
alex: thanks all :rocket:
